_meta._note: Bulk ingest of 594 ECI contributing benchmark scores from epoch-research/benchmark-stitching GitHub repo (https://github.com/epoch-research/benchmark-stitching/tree/main/data) — referenced by Rosetta Stone paper (arxiv 2512.00193). 33 external_benchmark_*.csv files cover all 35 'External Leaderboards' + 'Developer Reported' ECI contributors. Each CSV has 'Source' + 'Source link' columns providing primary-source attribution per ((model, score)) pair. 10 new benchmark registrations: ['arc_ai2_easy', 'lech_mazur_writing', 'scienceqa', 'openbookqa', 'lambada', 'csqa2', 'anli', 'superglue', 'boolq', 'cadeval'].
